title: Yallapp app build config
description: Everything needed to build one client's app. The platform writes it from the setup wizard; the build pipeline and the Flutter app read it. Secrets (signing keys, store API keys) are never part of this file.

client_id.description: The platform's client ID, for logs.

app_type.description: Which module the build includes: 'lms' (Academy), 'store' (WooCommerce), 'booking' (Amelia, BookingPress or LatePoint), 'real_estate' (property listings on the hosted API), 'news' (articles from WordPress, an own API, a feed or the dashboard), 'events' (events and tickets on the hosted API), 'donations' (charity campaigns and donations on the hosted API), 'delivery' (shipments and couriers on the hosted API), 'food' (105.1 food orders from many restaurants on the hosted API) or 'rides' (105.2 ride hailing on the hosted API).

vertical.description: Optional. The kind of business, on top of app_type: it changes wording and defaults in the app, never which module or screens it has. Left out for apps without one; apps treat an unknown value as none.

role.description: 104.6 Optional. Who the build is for: 'customer' (the default), the app for the company's customers; 'courier', a delivery company's second app for its couriers, with the courier's screens only, under its own package name and bundle ID ('courier' only with app_type 'delivery' or 'food'); 105.2 'driver', a ride company's second app for its drivers, with the driver's screens only, likewise ('driver' only with app_type 'rides').

site_url.description: The client's WordPress site. The app calls <site_url>/wp-json/yallapp/v1.

api_base_url.description: Optional. Where the app finds the Yallapp API, for sites without WordPress (a custom API or the hosted API). Defaults to <site_url>/wp-json/yallapp/v1.

auth_base_url.description: Optional. For an app on its own API that Yallapp signs people in to: Yallapp's hosted API for the app, https://yallapp.com.tr/api/app/{app_id}. The app sends sign-in, account and device calls there (Config.auth.provider 'yallapp'), and every other call to api_base_url with Yallapp's access token. Left out when the API at api_base_url signs people in.

logo_url.description: PNG or SVG shown on the sign-in screen.

firebase.description: Optional. Push notifications are off when missing.

analytics.description: Optional. 44 Where the app sends its usage statistics (docs/api/platform.yaml, tag Analytics): Yallapp's endpoint for this app and the app's analytics key. Left out of the app preview's config; without it the app sends nothing.

key.description: Sent as X-Yallapp-Analytics-Key. Not a secret: it is the same in every copy of the app.

huawei.description: Optional. 36 Huawei Push Kit, for Android phones without Google Play services (Huawei AppGallery). Without it those phones get no push notifications and the build leaves Huawei's SDK out.

links.description: Optional. 46 Links that open the app (docs/api/openapi.yaml, tag Links). The Android build adds an App Links intent filter (autoVerify) for each host and path, and the iOS build the Associated Domains entitlement (applinks:<host>). The app sends crash reports to crash_report_url.

yallapp_base_url.description: The app's links on Yallapp's link domain: https://yallapp.com.tr/a/{app_id}.

site_base_url.description: A WordPress app's links on its own site: <site URL>/a, which the plugin serves; the link files themselves are at the root of the site's domain. Left out for apps without WordPress.

site_paths.description: 48 The paths of the WordPress site's own pages that open the app (permalink bases like /courses/ and /product/, as the plugin reported them with its license check): the Android build adds an intent filter for each on the site's host. Needs site_base_url. Left out when there are none.

crash_report_url.description: POST /crashes at Yallapp for this app: https://yallapp.com.tr/api/app/{app_id}/crashes.
